shortDescription: Module for creating and deleting proxy groups, and updating existing ones.

options.name: failover_delay
options.description: Failover period for each proxy in the group to have the online/offline state. Time suffixes are supported, e.g. 30s, 1m. User macros are supported. Possible values between 10s-15m. Set empty to reset to the default value.

options.name: min_online
options.description: Minimum number of online proxies required for the group to be online. User macros are supported. Possible value range 1-1000. Set empty to reset to the default value.

options.name: state
options.description: Create or delete a proxy group.
